openFindings.title: Managed steward cwd locator is the legacy helper, skipping Handle/trusted locator
openFindings.detail: On origin/main aa44194 (#871), resolveAuthorizedToolCwd treats stewardException as a special case: it resolves locator from stewardWorkspaceDir (helper path from resolveEmployeeBuiltinStewardWorkspaceDir) and does not call resolveTrustedAgentLocator. authorizeWorkspaceRootAccess then catalogs/authorizes that helper path. User-visible cwd remains the helper. This is not a controlled Handle deciding the managed path, and the helper is an authorization basis rather than shadow-only comparison. Production-observation deploy, Stage C Accept, implementationVerified, LIVE, Stage D/E remain unauthorized.
